experiments.title: Test a missing resource
experiments.instruction: Predict whether extra light can restore activity when water is absent. Choose a prediction, then Test zero water and extra light. Keep carbon dioxide fixed.
experiments.observe: Activity remains zero. Explain why light cannot replace water in sugar production.

experiments.title: Find the limiting resource
experiments.instruction: Reset experiment, Save comparison, then predict what raising water above 80% will do while light 70% and carbon dioxide 80% remain fixed. Raise only water.
experiments.observe: Activity first rises, then light becomes limiting. Compare the saved trial and explain why more water cannot replace light.
